client_status_timestamps.name: client_status_timestamps
client_status_timestamps.value: ("identity"."client_profiles"."status" <> 'active' OR "identity"."client_profiles"."activated_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("identity"."client_profiles"."status" <> 'archived' OR "identity"."client_profiles"."archived_at" IS NOT NULL)

coach_profiles_parent.name: coach_profiles_parent
coach_profiles_parent.where: "identity"."coach_profiles"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "identity"."coach_profiles"."parent_coach_id" IS NOT NULL

users_email_or_social.name: users_email_or_social
users_email_or_social.value: "identity"."users"."password_hash" IS NOT NULL OR "identity"."users"."email_verified_at" IS NOT NULL

set_has_measurement.name: set_has_measurement
set_has_measurement.value: "training"."set_logs"."reps" IS NOT NULL OR "training"."set_logs"."duration_seconds" IS NOT NULL OR "training"."set_logs"."distance_m" IS NOT NULL

sessions_client_day_unique.name: sessions_client_day_unique
sessions_client_day_unique.where: "training"."workout_sessions"."program_day_id" IS NOT NULL AND "training"."workout_sessions"."deleted_at" IS NULL

session_completion.name: session_completion
session_completion.value: "training"."workout_sessions"."status" <> 'completed' OR ("training"."workout_sessions"."started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "training"."workout_sessions"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)

item_identified.name: item_identified
item_identified.value: "nutrition"."meal_items"."food_id" IS NOT NULL OR "nutrition"."meal_items"."custom_name" IS NOT NULL

comment_has_content.name: comment_has_content
comment_has_content.value: "coaching"."comments"."body" IS NOT NULL OR "coaching"."comments"."voice_note_asset_id" IS NOT NULL OR "coaching"."comments"."video_reply_asset_id" IS NOT NULL OR "coaching"."comments"."annotation" IS NOT NULL

recording_requires_dual_consent.name: recording_requires_dual_consent
recording_requires_dual_consent.value: "coaching"."live_sessions"."recording_asset_id" IS NULL OR ("coaching"."live_sessions"."coach_consent_at" IS NOT NULL AND "coaching"."live_sessions"."client_consent_at" IS NOT NULL)

media_expiring.name: media_expiring
media_expiring.where: "coaching"."media_assets"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "coaching"."media_assets"."deleted_at" IS NULL

message_has_content.name: message_has_content
message_has_content.value: "coaching"."messages"."body" IS NOT NULL OR "coaching"."messages"."attachment_asset_id" IS NOT NULL
